title: Fisher information based lower bounds on the cost of quantum phase estimation
summary: Quantum phase estimation (QPE) is a cornerstone of quantum algorithms designed to estimate the eigenvalues of a unitary operator. QPE is typically implemented through two paradigms with distinct circuit structures: quantum Fourier transform-based QPE (QFT-QPE) and Hadamard test-based QPE (HT-QPE). Existing performance assessments fail to separate the statistical information inherent in the quantum circuit from the efficiency of classical post-processing, thereby obscuring the limits intrinsic to the circuit structure itself.
